ItemId.description: The rate's 26-character id. When it matches a stored rate, that rate is updated.

Currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency converted, such as EUR.

BaseCurrency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency converted to, such as USD.

Rate.description: How many units of the base currency one unit of the currency is worth.

Date.description: The day the rate takes effect, such as 2026-11-14.

Source.description: Where the rate came from: manual, or a provider's name.

Rates.description: The exchange rates to create or update.
